one_line: Early 2nd-century CE Saka (Indo-Scythian) Western Kshatrapa ruler of Gujarat and the western coast, known from his inscriptions and coins.

appearance.age_look: mid-40s, tall and broad-shouldered with a seasoned warrior’s build
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, straight nose, medium tan complexion, faint crow’s feet at the eyes, neatly groomed short beard and moustache, and a calm but vigilant default expression that hints at careful calculation.
appearance.hair: Thick dark-brown hair cut to just above the shoulders, straight and slightly layered, parted slightly off-center; he wears a plain, snug white cloth headband tied at the back, with the knot and short tails visible.
appearance.costume: A knee-length, long-sleeved front-wrapped coat (Saka-style tunic) of muted indigo wool, overlapping left over right and secured with a broad leather belt; the coat has a narrow V-neck showing a high-collared, off-white linen under-tunic and is edged with a simple continuous red woven border; below, he wears straight, slightly loose off-white trousers tucked neatly into mid-calf brown leather boots; over his left shoulder is a plain, undyed woollen shawl (chaddar) with a subtle herringbone texture, draped diagonally across his chest and pinned near the right hip with a small round bronze brooch; he wears minimal jewellery—small round silver stud earrings, a single simple silver bangle on his right wrist, and a thin cord amulet under his tunic only faintly suggested at the neckline.
appearance.signature: A straight double-edged iron sword with a slightly tapering blade, a simple bronze crossguard, and a brown leather-wrapped hilt, worn in a plain brown leather scabbard hanging from his belt on the left hip, the scabbard tip ending just above his knee.

ref_desc: Chashtana is a mid-40s, tall, broad-shouldered Saka ruler with a tan oval face, short beard, shoulder-length dark-brown hair and a white headband, wearing a muted indigo front-wrapped tunic with red edging, off-white trousers, brown boots, a undyed wool shawl, minimal silver jewellery, and carrying a bronze-hilted straight sword in a brown leather scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Chashtana, an early 2nd-century CE Saka Western Kshatrapa ruler: a mid-40s, tall, broad-shouldered man with an oval tan face, high cheekbones, straight nose, faint crow’s feet, and a calm, vigilant expression; he has neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, thick dark-brown hair cut just above the shoulders, straight and slightly layered, parted off-center, and a snug white cloth headband tied at the back with the knot and short tails visible. He wears a knee-length, long-sleeved front-wrapped muted indigo wool tunic overlapping left over right, with a narrow V-neck showing a high-collared off-white linen under-tunic, and a continuous simple red woven border along the edges; the tunic is cinched with a broad brown leather belt. His off-white straight trousers are tucked into sturdy mid-calf brown leather boots. Over his left shoulder, drape an undyed wool shawl with subtle herringbone texture diagonally across his chest, pinned near the right hip with a small round bronze brooch. Add small round silver stud earrings, a single simple silver bangle on his right wrist, and only the faint suggestion of a cord amulet under his tunic at the neckline. At his left hip, attached to the belt, show a straight double-edged iron sword with a slightly tapering blade, a simple bronze crossguard, and a brown leather-wrapped hilt, housed in a plain brown leather scabbard ending just above his knee. Use a palette of muted indigo, off-white, brown leather, bronze, and red trim, and present him in clear front, side, and three-quarter views in a consistent shonen anime style with realistic, historically grounded clothing and accessories.
